name: Fathom Analytics
verdict_reason: Fathom charges $15/mo for privacy-friendly analytics; Plausible and Umami are the same promise as software you run. The Plausible compose on this scoreboard is already boot-verified — same replacement, same math, one more subscription that's really a database with a chart on top.
what_you_lose: Fathom's managed uptime and their EU isolation guarantees on paper
Email reports arrive from your cron now
